from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """A record of the investing activities cash flow found in a specific document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The legal name of the company the document pertains to")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    cash_flow_description: str | None = Field(description="The description of the line item (e.g. 'Net cash provided by investing activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the cash flow")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim line containing the cash flow figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investing_cash_flows: list[InvestingCashFlow]
